name: Sensi Star
summary: **Sensi Star** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Paradise Seeds]], selected from [[afghani|Afghani]] and Indian indica lines with a Skunk infusion. Released in 1994, it won the Cannabis Cup and Highlife Cup in Amsterdam in 1999.

sources.title: Sensi Star Strain Story, the Strongest Indica
